native.command: cargo test -p clubscape-game-types -p clubscape-simulation -p clubscape-world-engine -p clubscape-content -p clubscape-protocol -p clubscape-server -p clubscape-client-core --all-targets --quiet

source_dialogue_entries.native_fixture_correction: The pre-existing net entitlement is complete only with its satisfied item set populated; no runtime validation was weakened and no inventory item was granted by this fixture correction.
source_dialogue_entries.scope: Post-104+7 source normalization and real native UI/entry checks on controlled source states, not a fresh player journey.

canonical_anvil_legacy_protocol.scope: Exact observed stage/items/XP/location reconstructed only as controlled test preconditions against the real canonical4 artifact. Native public-protocol/view regression plus real authenticated PostgreSQL journal; not a full fresh-account HTTP journey.

canonical_engine_ui_probes.scope: Real unmodified source content and engine on controlled component preconditions; not a fresh journey.

required_asset_publication.policy: All four validated immutable layers preserve source/reference/audio inputs. Required original items/models and replacement outcomes remain intact; no null icons, aliases or relaxed startup checks.

caller_contract.input: WorldInput.ui / GameplayUiIntent; ordinary operation UUID and contiguous sequence
caller_contract.production_target: Option<WorldTarget> / WorldTarget|null; absent protobuf target for genuine inventory-only production
caller_contract.inventory_production: UseItem on an inventory slot opens a source menu. Trusted typed selection retains both slots/stacks/instances through selection and first completion; stale identities cannot consume another matching copy.
caller_contract.bank_precondition: GameplayUiRequest.expected_bank_revision must echo ui.bank.revision as a decimal string; validated after duplicate receipt lookup

renderer_observer.dynamic_objects: WorldView.dynamicObjects?:DynamicObjectView[] forwards unchanged protocol field13; canonical objectId maps to optional sourceId only through the validated catalogue
renderer_observer.timing: stable action-instance ID, startedAtTick, cycleStartedAtTick, nextActionTick, observedAtTick; all clocks decimal strings
renderer_observer.movement: actual executed current-tick movement; final run step remains true after idle/exhaustion, then clears on a nonmoving tick
renderer_observer.animation: explicit source reference first; baseline-qualified exact method/recipe numeric bindings; otherwise exact source action/recipe/style/spell identity, never nearby-object or unrelated sequence guessing

caller_contract.migration: Stop the coordinator; configure a complete target game root; cargo run --locked -p clubscape-server -- migrate-ui --from <exact-old-raw-artifact-sha256>
caller_contract.preserved: Items, XP, entitlements, clocks, sequences, private RNG, acknowledged receipts, account-only mode, renderer/audio ABI and unchanged source gameplay checkpoints.
